findings.claim: cli-login.md and localstack-cli.md said `localstack token` prints only a token, and no reference page covered `token s3 ROLE` or `--endpoint`.
the prefix test did not fail when a mapped folder was the hermes root or above it.

verdict.text: Narrow round.
The f1 fix is accurate: every claim the docs now make about `localstack token s3 ROLE` matches `commands/token.py` and `auth/sts.py`.
f2 is fixed too.
The gates are green when I stamp them myself.
Pass.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pass on pre_commit, cli_tests and eval rows r1 to r6 and r8.
Stamp green 523907948ed351f1e04f640fd7fe524b144f0bacefa9e392438f52cfb060e19f.
docs/reference/cli-login.md, "`token` is for scripts": the `eval` usage matches the token.py docstring.
The Vault path `identity/oidc/token/ROLE` and the session's Vault token match `sts.s3_credentials`.
The RoleArn `arn:aws:iam::role/ROLE` matches `_assume_role`.
The three export names match `S3Credentials.exports`, and `shlex.quote` makes them safe to `eval`.
The 15 minutes match `DURATION_SECONDS = 900`.
"stderr says when they expire" matches the `print(..., file=sys.stderr)`.
The `--endpoint` default matches `sts.DEFAULT_ENDPOINT`.

"A failure, or no role, exits non-zero with empty stdout" holds: a missing role, `StsError` and session errors all go through `_common.fail`, which writes to stderr and returns `typer.Exit(1)`, and stdout gets written only after the credentials are in hand.
The front-matter sources now list `auth/sts.py`.
.okf/components/localstack-cli.md: the added sentence (three `export` lines, no shim calls it, the empty-stdout rule still holds) is correct.
f2: `test_no_consumer_prefix_folder_contains_another_or_the_hermes_root` now asserts that no mapped prefix is a prefix of `HERMES_ROOT`, so it fails on the root or anything above it.
f1: resolved in docs/reference/cli-login.md ("`token` is for scripts") and .okf/components/localstack-cli.md (Shims section), as above.
f2: resolved in cli/tests/test_local_ov_sync.py:66-69.
The `description` front matter of .okf/components/localstack-cli.md still says "stdout of `token` is the token alone".
That is about the shim contract and is no less true than before, so I do not raise it.
It could say "for the shimmed services" in a later edit.
